ops.title: Check cancellation during snapshot location metadata batches
ops.description: Source audit proves locate and locate_step omit per-item token/deadline checks across root, cached-location, pending-output and recursive metadata batches. Cancellation signal itself is atomic and PyO3 native requests detach from GIL. Root approved a bounded fix after deterministic CI baseline reproduction, independent review and full CI. Exact old worker20838 timeout attribution remains UNKNOWN. Diagnosis: /Users/yasyf/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/runs/20261026T235128-repeat/fundamental-efficiency/capt-cancellation-source-current.json. Preserve budgets, cursor/resume, errors, ordering, authority and official SDK17 carrier ownership; no local tests/builds/runtime queries/signals.
